title: docs(data-modeling): virtual objects — rows from your server, shown in any view (plugin-driver recipe)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiVy7F2atKWpo5rp3YPrqddh)_

Fixes #27278
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新增文档页「虚拟对象」：三分法（计算型 / 不可落地 / 实时 ⇒ 虚拟；慢变参考数据 ⇒ 真对象 + 定时拉取）、插件 driver 完整配方（driver 骨架、插件、数据源、外部对象、`current_user` 锁公式、`beforeUpdate` 守卫、甘特视图、权限集）、driver 实际收到的调用、共享模型规则、driver 形状 pin 测试模板、五个业务例；从 external-datasources、drivers 与模块首页链入。
- **为什么改：** #27130 这类客户要「行来自自家服务器、任何视图可看可改」，平台零协议改动已能做到，但没有一页可照抄的配方；AI 作者也照这页写。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯文档（外加文档审计范围清单自动生成的一行），revert 即回滚；页内整套栈与 driver 骨架已在真实 kernel 中启动跑通（见 Tests）。
- **先看：** `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx` 的「Credentials」段（实测：插件 driver 的数据源上 `credentialsRef` 不被解析）与「Choose the sharing model on purpose」提示框；其次第一个 driver 骨架代码块。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`，预期 `✅ 272 prose examples type-check`，页内两个 `os:check` 代码块在其中（变异后报 `virtual-objects.mdx:140` 与 `:288`）。
- **需要你做的：** 定夺插件 driver 的凭据通道（Acceptance notes 第 1 条）；页面目前只写实测事实，并按插件约定让宿主经插件选项传入。

## What changes

- **New page `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx`** ("Virtual objects — rows from your server, shown in any view"):
  - the three-way rule as a decision table (computed / must-not-land / real-time ⇒ virtual; slow-changing reference data ⇒ a real object fed by a scheduled pull), plus the pointer to federation when the remote is a reachable SQL database;
  - the recipe, worked as a port berth plan: the driver skeleton (translate the whole `where` or refuse by name, forward only remote-owned columns on `update`, `supports.transactionsUnsupported`), the plugin that publishes `driver.NAME` in `init`, and one `defineStack` block with the datasource (`driver` = the service suffix, `config: {}`, `checkOnBoot: false`), the external object (`sharingModel: 'public_read_write'`, the per-caller `locked` formula over `current_user`), the `beforeUpdate` guard with declared refusals, the gantt list view and a permission set;
  - the "a driver cannot opt out of correctness" rules, with #27277's engine floor named as planned, not existing;
  - the sharing-model callout (default model refuses every member edit; link #27332, no fix promised);
  - what the driver receives, call by call, as measured (object name not `remoteName`, `object` inside the query, the extra `id` / `updated_at` / `updated_by` keys, by-id reads before a write);
  - the driver shape-pin test template;
  - five business examples: port berth scheduling, SAP sales orders, HR directory, equipment live status, and the counter-example (codes and registries as a real object with a `mapping` + `job` pull).
- **Links in:** a callout sentence and a See-also row on `external-datasources.mdx`, a paragraph after "Writing a driver" on `drivers.mdx`, a card on `data-modeling/index.mdx`, the nav entry in `data-modeling/meta.json`.
- **`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`:** the one-line regeneration `check-audit-scope.mjs --write` produces for a new page.

## Tests

Docs only; nothing published changes. Every code block on the page was run before it was written down:

- **The whole recipe boots.** A throwaway copy of the reference test's boot harness (`packages/runtime`, same plugin set as `plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts`) with the page's driver skeleton, plugin and `defineStack` block (identical but for comments) behind an in-memory transport: 6/6 passed under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). Measured: list read with the view's filter, sort and `top=50` reaches the remote as `filter [archived eq false]`, `sort start_date asc`, `limit 50`, then a `count` with the same filter; the formula reads `locked: false` for the planner and `true` for the administrator; a PATCH on a locked slot answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` / `declaredCode: PLAN_LOCKED`; the administrator's PATCH answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` / `declaredCode: NOT_PLANNER` with no remote write; the planner's PATCH makes three by-id reads and one `patch` carrying exactly `start_date`, `end_date`, `plan_note`; an outsider's list read is `403`; a filter the driver refuses (`>=`) answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`. The probe files were deleted; the tree carries no new test.
- **The shape-pin template passes against the skeleton:** 5/5 (`vitest run`, identical text to the page's block except the import path).
- **The reference test still holds on this base:** `plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` 12/12 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- **The `os:check` blocks are really compiled:** with `transactionsUnsupported: 'yes'` and `sharingModel: 'public_rw'` injected, `check:skill-examples` exits 1 naming `virtual-objects.mdx:140:17` and `:288:7`; restored by `git checkout HEAD`, blob hash equal to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

1. **`credentialsRef` is not resolved for a plugin driver** (measured, seam level). `DatasourceConnectionService.attemptConnect` returns `already-registered` for a driver a plugin registered before it reaches credential resolution. Probe on `6d7634a9`: pre-registered driver + `credentialsRef` ⇒ `already-registered` with no secret store and with a resolver (resolver calls 0); not pre-registered ⇒ `failed-credentials` / `connected` (resolver calls 1). So the fail-closed sentence in external-datasources §4 does not hold for a plugin driver, and the epic's standing rule "credentials only through `credentialsRef`" has no channel on Tier A today. The page states the fact and points to the plugin convention (the host passes options to the plugin it composes); it does not claim a platform channel. Not filed: the reach is a seam probe, not a public door.
2. **"DataSync" in the card is spelled as what exists.** `DataSyncConfig` is retired (never executed); a sync is defined on its target as a `mapping` with `connectorSource` driven by a `job` `pull`. The counter-example links `/docs/automation/jobs#pulling-a-mapping` and says there is no separate data-sync type.
3. **Mounting through `defineStack({ plugins })` is not measured under `objectstack serve`.** The boot probe composes with `kernel.use`, as the reference test does; the `plugins` sentence follows the documented plugin convention (`plugins/development` step 6), and the "register in `init`" rule rests on reading `ObjectQLPlugin.start` (adopts `driver.*` services) and `AppPlugin.start` (connects declared datasources).
4. **Owner-column route** (the second way out of the sharing rule) is named and marked as not covered by the reference test.
5. **#27130 is not answered here**; per the card the triage seat replies after this lands.
6. **The card's #27277 item "Driver shape pin test template in the guide (P1-2)"** is carried by the template section; #27277's helper, row cap and refusal envelopes are described only as planned.
